title: The Abandoned Colony
logline: The lone survivor of an abandoned colony needs a pilot to destroy a corporate liquidation drone sent to erase all records of their existence.

roles.description: Dull, meticulous, refuses to leave their post even as the walls crumble.
Clinical, obsessed with spreadsheets, completely emotionless.
A rusting domed city orbiting a dying star, entirely empty except for one office.
A massive automated ship designed to dismantle structures.
The monolithic company that built and abandoned the colony.

public_situation: The {role:terraforming_corp} has written off the {role:ruined_colony} as a total loss and dispatched a drone to recycle the metal.
private_truth: The survivor is the colony's former accountant, who stayed behind to meticulously log every death caused by the corporation's faulty life support systems.

beats.public_change: The liquidation drone arrives and begins systematically tearing apart the outer domes.

missions.reason: The liquidator hires the pilot to scan the colony to ensure no biological assets remain before they vaporize it.
missions.private_fact: The pilot discovers the survivor sitting calmly at a desk in the center of the ruins.

beats.public_change: The drone targets the central administrative block where the survivor is working.

missions.reason: The survivor asks the pilot to land at the crumbling dome's airlock and collect the master ledger of all the deaths.
missions.private_fact: The survivor refuses to leave with the ledger, stating their job is to go down with the archives.

beats.public_change: The drone powers up its main plasma cutters, preparing to melt the administrative block.

missions.reason: The survivor begs the pilot to destroy the drone and recover its targeting core to prove the corporation ordered the erasure.
missions.private_fact: The liquidator hails the pilot, offering to pay them double if they just fly away and let the drone finish its work.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the ledger. The drone is about to fire. The liquidator offers a bribe to walk away.

options.label: Destroy the drone and publish the ledger
Walk away and let the colony burn

resolutions.summary: The drone is destroyed. The pilot publishes the ledger, exposing the corporation's negligence. The survivor dies peacefully in the ruins, their duty fulfilled.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot exposed a massive corporate cover-up to honor the last wish of a doomed accountant.

resolutions.summary: The pilot takes the bribe. The drone vaporizes the survivor and the ruins. The corporation covers up the deaths forever.
The drone finishes its work unimpeded. The colony is erased, and the survivor is quietly shipped off to a corporate re-education center.

loose_threads.detail: The life support systems didn't fail naturally; the corporation deliberately sabotaged them to avoid paying bonuses.
The liquidator casually mentions they've done this to three other colonies this year alone.

radio_hooks: {role:ruined_colony} scheduled for final orbital liquidation today.
{role:terraforming_corp} assures investors that all liabilities are handled.

voice_direction.lone_survivor: Flat, precise, completely detached from reality.
voice_direction.corporate_liquidator: Brisk, impatient, speaks entirely in corporate jargon.
